notes.title: Happy Jingle Jam! Drive Yogscast tanks in ConnecTank
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40311262/e413b71667afed6f63d8bef2f490298c7e7cafac.png[/img]

The ConnecTank team are delighted to be part of Jingle Jam and we made new tanks to thank you for playing our game. ConnecTank has three new Yogscast tanks so you can fetch a scratching post for Finneas Fatcat XV with a tank inspired by Lewis, scour the desert for Lord Longneck’s lost artwork as a tank inspired by Simon, and wreak havoc in a Sharky tank. All three tanks are unlocked after completing the game's tutorial.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40311262/3ac8d85b1f954f4930ed794c8d0740c3aca17111.png[/img]

Happy Holidays,
The ConnecTank team

notes.title: Livestream with the devs
notes.notes:
ConnecTank's demo is live on Steam! Drive big honking tanks, craft ammo, and deliver packages throughout New Pangea in the demo.

Also on Monday, June 21 at 10:00 PDT, we'll have members from the ConnecTank dev team on hand to answer questions and share behind-the-scenes information about how we made the puzzle action game.
